summary: Delivery actions sanitize runtime proof inputs, bound names and notes, validate structured image data URLs and retain the existing photo-storage budget.
Unknown failure reasons reject before mutation; valid failures store the same bounded note in the stop proof and activity event, preserving state/report consistency.

Tailwind scans application source explicitly, fixing the observed Windows dependency-path build error and avoiding unrelated snapshot/artifact class candidates; the default production build now passes.
Nine learning guides include real store/action traces, before-and-after code, executable exercise solutions, an exact original store snapshot and two reviewed production-browser screenshots.

checks.environment: Windows; Node 22.16.0; Next 16.3.1; React 19.2.8; TypeScript 5.9.3; Vitest 4.1.10; Tailwind 4.3.3; installed local browser selected by the original Puppeteer smoke script
checks.command: Installed Vitest full suite --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000; tsc --noEmit; eslint . --max-warnings=0; default next build; original smoke-e2e.mjs against an owned local production server

limits: This remains a browser-local demonstration with no authentication, tenant authorization or transactional server database.
Photo validation checks data URL structure and existing storage budget; it does not decode image pixels or validate MIME contents.
The final successful build uses the default Turbopack command after scoping Tailwind to src. Earlier unscoped Turbopack and Webpack attempts failed and remain recorded.
The final checks used the installed staged dependency tree. Root independently captured tests, typecheck, lint, production build and browser smoke, but did not recapture a clean pnpm installation.
